BJP members shouted slogans against the Karnataka government for not playing the Vande Mataram in full.

The BJP legislators recited the full version of Vande Mataram at the beginning of the Legislative Assembly and Council proceedings on Monday (September 21, 2026), when the recording that was officially played in the House ended after two stanzas.
